steps.label: What opioids are
lines: Opioids are drugs obtained from the poppy plant,
They bind to specific receptors of the central
nervous system and of the alimentary canal.
steps.why: Both facts are needed before the two named drugs: one plant is the source of the whole group, and the receptors explain why the group acts on the brain and the gut.
common_mistakes: Naming the wrong plant. Opioids come from Papaver somniferum, not from Cannabis sativa.
Leaving out the receptors. The binding site is part of the definition.
steps.memory_tip: One plant, two receptor sites: poppy, then brain and gut.
steps.margin_note: Two lines: the source plant and the receptors. Then take the two drugs one at a time.

steps.label: Morphine
lines: Morphine is produced from the dried latex of the
unripe fruits of the poppy plant.
It is a colourless crystal or a white
crystalline powder. It is taken orally or by
It is an effective sedative and pain killer, so
it is used for surgery patients and for people
steps.why: Morphine carries the larger part of this answer because it has a medical use, so its source, its form, how it is taken and what it is used for are all marked.
common_mistakes: Writing that morphine is made from heroin. Heroin is made FROM morphine.
Leaving out the medical use. The sedative and pain-killing use is part of the mark.
steps.memory_tip: Morphine is the medicine of the group: sedative and pain killer from the dried latex.
steps.margin_note: Four facts in three lines: source, form, route, use. Two marks sit here.

steps.label: Heroin

lines.text: Heroin = diacetyl morphine, also called smack

lines: Heroin is produced from morphine by acetylation.
It is a white bitter powder and is taken by
Heroin depresses the body and slows down the
steps.why: Heroin is morphine changed by one chemical step, so writing that step is what shows the two drugs belong to one family rather than being unrelated.
common_mistakes: Writing that heroin comes straight from the poppy plant. It is made from morphine.
Writing that heroin excites the body. It depresses and slows the body functions.
steps.memory_tip: Add acetyl to morphine and you get heroin, the street name of which is smack.
steps.margin_note: The chemical name in the box, then three short lines. One mark.

insider_note: 'Short notes' still means named headings, so write Morphine and Heroin as separate labelled points.
